name: Built At Lightspeed

sources.title: Submit Your Listing — $79 one-time per listing, instant publish, dofollow link; account via email or Google

requirements: Templates, themes, UI kits, boilerplates for the modern stack ONLY (Next.js, Astro, React, Vue, Tailwind, Webflow, etc.) — a SaaS product that isn't a template/theme doesn't fit
$79 one-time per listing — 'no commission, no monthly fee, no charge to keep a published listing online'
Account required (email or Google); creating a brand is free
Exception: if they already seeded your product, claiming the listing is FREE and transfers the whole brand
preparation: The stack it's built on (Next.js/Astro/Tailwind etc.)
Two links: demo URL and buy/sales page URL
workflow: Check if your product is already seeded — if so, claim it free instead of paying
Create an account (email or Google), create a brand
Draft the listing — AI-assisted: enter your URL and it drafts the listing with screenshots
Pay $79 once and publish — instant, no review queue
Edit/update the listing anytime from the account
watchFor: Batch seed path /submit/opensource works but the generic route is /submit
Niche fit: only for themes/templates/UI kits/boilerplates — don't submit a general SaaS
They don't process sales — the dofollow link points to YOUR sell page
New listings get top placement on homepage and category pages ordered by publish date
countsAsLive: The listing page is immediately public and appears at the top of the homepage and its category (ordered by published date)
unknowns: Whether unsuitable listings get refunded/removed post-publish
Traffic levels beyond 'strong traffic' marketing copy
Refund policy if the listing doesn't fit
